Free technical SEO checkers

Enter a URL, get the result. No signup.

  • Robots.txt checker and tester
    Check a site's robots.txt, see whether it blocks crawlers, and test whether a path is allowed for Googlebot.
  • XML sitemap validator
    Validate an XML sitemap: check the format, count URLs and find duplicates, http links and URLs on other hosts.
  • Redirect checker
    Follow a URL's redirects step by step and find long chains, loops and temporary redirects.
  • HTTP header checker
    See a URL's status code and response headers, including X-Robots-Tag and common security headers.
  • Structured data checker
    Find JSON-LD structured data on a page, catch invalid JSON and missing key properties.
  • Hreflang checker
    Check a page's hreflang tags for duplicates, invalid codes, a missing x-default and a missing self-reference.
